title: GRANULAR LONG HANN (Digitone insert)
author: analoglav
description: Experimental sound-quality revision of VM76: 2.73s 512KiB stereo capture history at 48kHz, two overlapping Hann-window grains per voice, grain length CC36 120..360ms in 5ms steps (240ms default), 80ms wet fade after 1.875s arm. CC33/34 pitch options -12,-7,-5,0,+5,+7,+12,+24 (defaults +5/+12), CC37 position 0..62.5ms, CC60 dry/wet. Q20.12 pitch accum avoids 32-bit overflow for +24 & 360ms. Original FM, Delay, Reverb, video unchanged. Mute root cause remains under investigation; no audio/stock mute patch applied.
